contract.health: GET /api/health is static, no-store, and exposes the deployed version and open/closed/fenced admission state without configuration or SQL work.
contract.closed: Previously accepted signed continuations and provider callbacks retain their ordinary authentication.
contract.fenced: All HTTP except GET /api/health returns 503 before runtime/SQL construction; native Modal and local-fetch deliveries stay pending. Metadata Workflows remain available for restore.

remaining: Actual fenced restore/snapshot proof and all domain restore transformations.
Any scheduled handler must refuse new periodic work while fenced.
Placement affects fetch handlers only, not Workflow execution or RPC entrypoints.
